results.label: Disable break-even
results.mechanism_note: Remove break-even stop lifting to measure whether O1 is prematurely flattening trades that later pay.

results.label: Earlier tighter break-even
results.mechanism_note: Arm break-even earlier and with a smaller cushion to test whether faster risk neutralization improves net by cutting reversals.

results.label: Later break-even
results.mechanism_note: Delay break-even arming to test whether O1 is cutting trades too early before they can reach managed targets.

results.label: Disable trailing stop
results.mechanism_note: Turn trailing off to measure whether O1 tail management is helping or just clipping winners.

results.label: Earlier tighter trailing
results.mechanism_note: Activate trailing sooner with a tighter offset to test whether faster profit protection reduces giveback on reversals.

results.label: Later wider trailing
results.mechanism_note: Delay trailing and widen its offset to test whether O1 is over-tight on winning trades.

results.label: Shorter max hold
results.mechanism_note: Reduce max holding time to 120 minutes to test whether stale intraday positions are hurting O1 net.

results.label: Longer max hold
results.mechanism_note: Extend max holding time to 240 minutes to test whether O1 is exiting too early on slow intraday trends.
